bullets.text: LilaConnect's Successful Migration - **LilaConnect** migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing customer onboarding and operational efficiency.
Chelsea Stadium Connectivity Boost - **O2** upgraded mobile infrastructure at **Chelsea FC**'s Stamford Bridge for improved fan experience.
Liberty Global's Acquisition Talks - **Liberty Global** is in discussions to acquire **Three Ireland** for up to €1.5 billion.
Ericsson Job Cuts - **Ericsson** plans to cut 1,600 jobs in Sweden to improve competitiveness amid financial challenges.
Longer Radio Spectrum Access - Proposed EU regulations may grant telecom operators longer access to radio spectrum, aiding network planning.
NTT DATA's Marine Cable Project - **NTT DATA** leads a consortium to build a $1 billion submarine cable linking Asia.
AI Integration at Verizon - **Verizon** is applying AI within its network to enhance efficiency and support enterprise services.
MaxCell's Brand Refresh - **MaxCell** unveils a new brand identity to meet rising demand for high-density fiber infrastructure.
Private 5G Security Gaps - Bridging security gaps in **Private 5G** networks is crucial for protecting enterprise operations.
